notes.grammar: terraces joined by walkable slopes (nr_ families climb 8/16/32 across a tile, md_16b too) with cliffs between (md_ families: a steep band of 50 degrees and more)
notes.walls: the play area is closed by the same md_ cliffs (16 to 32 high, nothing behind)
notes.trails: nr_16a_tu / nr_32a_tu: paths cut into a cliff; left out for now
notes.river: bridged where it runs straight: Misareaux's stone footbridge (fa_hasi00, made for its 8-deep river) or Lufaise's rope bridge, whichever was built for the gap nearest ours
notes.sea: seabed se_lw_fl1-4 under a still translucent umi3 surface at -34; the source's waves, splashes and shore surf laid by shores facing their way; the generators drawing its flat sea sheets (umi0, umi3) left out: moved, they showed as boxes
notes.roles: slopes (walkable, measured: steady climb across the tile): nr_16a, nr_32a, md_16b; cliffs and walls: md_8a, md_16a, md_32a and their transitions
notes.heights: walkable mesas climb 16 at a time (md_16b ramps); rocks stand 16 or 32 (md_32a with md_16a32a where the top steps); no 32 ramp exists
notes.mesas: a mesa is all cliff (md_16a: sheer rock, scenery) or all slope (nr_16a: a walkable hill); the two never meet along an edge, so mesas stand apart; reach 0.7 lets some be rock
notes.coast: an island ringed by sea cliffs: se_md_32a st/coi/coo (land at 0, sea ~ -34, holes on the sea side), se_md_16a32a where the top steps; a fence along the cliff tops
notes.ramps: a way up through a rock line: one side of a cliff mesa is md_16b (a gentle cliff-family slope), its two corners md_16b16a_coi1 (the switch); the rest md_16a cliff. Never on the outer edge
notes.bridges: each crossing takes the bridge built for the gap nearest its own: Misareaux's rope bridge (74) and stone footbridge, Lufaise's (24) rope bridge (a deck of two mirrored halves, rails of four)
notes.sea effects: effe/umi1, umi2: foam, swell and surf generators by south, east, north and west-facing sea cliffs; each laid by one of ours facing the same way, at the same offset
